title: Negotiating and persuading / Ukudlulisela nokukhombisa
bridge: NgesiSpani, ukuze sikkhombise, siyathanda ukusebenzisa izinqubo eziqondile njengokuthi 'deberías' okanye 'tienes que', nokusetshenziswa kwesubjunctive ezikhaleni ezinye 'para que'. NgesiNgesi, i-B2 iyafuna itone elingekayo nokulondekile, ukusetshenziswa kwawo 'would', 'could', 'might' nokuthi 'I was wondering if...'. Qaphela ukubhala ngokungafani 'hacer una contraoferta' njengokuthi 'to make a counteroffer' (okuhle) kodwa isithi 'to suggest' aliyithathi isubjunctive ngesiNgesi, kodwa ithatha umculo wesithi (suggest + infinitive). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkomba zokubeka imibuzo (isn't it?) ukuze kutholake isivumelano (isn't it?) asiyikwazi ukubalulekwa ngokufanayo njengokuthi '¿no?', ngoba ngesiNgesi kufanele kuba khona isivumelano nomphumela wesithi esikhaleni esikhulu.
rule: Ukuze udlulisele nokukhombisa ngesiNgesi B2, kuthathwa: 1) Izithi zokuhlula: 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Izinhlelo zokukhuluma ngokuhle: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Izinkulumo zokwenza izinto ezinye: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Izinkulumo zokufika esivumelweni: 'What if we...?', 'How about...? + -ing', 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Isubjective yokuhlalisa izinto: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (isubjective esibili). Ngokukhombisa, kuthathwa izinkulumo njengokuthi 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...'. Okubalulekile: ngesiNgesi, 'suggest' no 'recommend' zenziwe ngokuthi that + isubject + isithi ngomculo wesithi (ngaphandle kwesithi 's'), okanye ngesithi: 'I suggest that we wait' / 'I suggest waiting'. Awusetshenziswa isubjective njengesiSpani.

concept_examples.text: Could we possibly meet halfway on the price?
concept_examples.translation: Ingabe singahlangana phakathi kwindawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli miːt ˌhæfˈweɪ ɒn ðə praɪs/

concept_examples.text: I was wondering if you might consider a discount for bulk orders.
concept_examples.translation: Ngibuzwa ukuthi ingabe ungahola ukuthola isikhwele sokuthenga ngokukhulu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju maɪt kənˈsɪdər ə dɪskaʊnt fɔː bʌlk ˈɔːrdərz/

concept_examples.text: What if we extend the deadline by a week? That could work for both of us.
concept_examples.translation: Yini na ukuba sikhethe indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla ngosuku olulodwa? Lokhu kungaba ngokweneleyo kubo bobabili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt ɪf wi ɪkˈstend ðə dedlaɪn baɪ ə wiːk ðæt kʊd wɜːrk fɔːr boʊθ əv ʌs/

concept_examples.text: If you agree to a lower price, we'll sign the contract today.
concept_examples.translation: Uma uvuma indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla eliphansi, siyohlela umyalo namhlanje.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə loʊər praɪs wiːl saɪn ðə ˈkɒntrækt təˈdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: I suggest that we should wait until next week.
common_error.correct: I suggest that we wait until next week.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest waiting until next week.
common_error.explanation: Impazamo iyaphuma ekusetshenzisweni kwesikhalo sesiSpani 'sugiero que debamos esperar' nesithi 'should'. NgesiNgesi, emva kwesithi 'suggest' (no 'recommend', 'propose'), kuthathwa isubjective ngesiNgesi, eyiyisithi ngomculo wesithi (ngaphandle kwesithi 's' nangesithi 'should'). Kungahleka ukusetshenziswa kwesikhalo esithi njengenkambhe. Kuyabalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi isubjective sesiSpani ayibalulekanga ngokwenze; ngesiNgesi kuthathwa umculo wesithi kubo bonke abantu, ngisho kuye 'he/she/it'.

examples.original: Would it be possible to get an extension?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɒsəbl tə ɡet ən ɪkˈstenʃən/
examples.translation: Ingabe kungaba yini na ukuthola isikhwele sokudlula?
examples.note: Sithatha 'would' esikhundleni 'will' ukuze sibe ngokuhle, njengesiSpani '¿Podría?'

examples.original: I was wondering if you could lower the price.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd ˈloʊər ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Ngibuzwa ukuthi ingabe ungahola ukuthola indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla.
examples.note: Isikhalo 'I was wondering if...' siyisikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa. Ungathathi 'I wondered' eyiyisikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa.

examples.original: Could we possibly agree on a different payment schedule?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli əˈɡriː ɒn ə ˈdɪfrənt ˈpeɪmənt ˈʃedjuːl/
examples.translation: Ingabe singahlela ukudlulisela isikhathi esikhulu sokuthenga?
examples.note: 'Possibly' siyiyona eyokhuluma ngokuhle. NgesiSpani sithi '¿Podríamos quizás?', kodwa 'possibly' siyifaka emva kwesubject.

examples.original: That's a fair point, but we can't go below ten percent.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə feər pɔɪnt bʌt wi kænt ɡəʊ bɪˈloʊ ten pəˈsent/
examples.translation: Yileyo indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla, kodwa asinakuhola phansi kwesikhombisa esikhashana.
examples.note: Ukubeka indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla ('That's a fair point') kuyabalulekile ngaphambi kokuthi uhambe phambili.

examples.original: If you agree to a longer contract, we could offer a better rate.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə ˈlɒŋɡər ˈkɒntrækt wi kʊd ˈɒfər ə ˈbetər reɪt/
examples.translation: Uma uvuma umyalo omkhulu, singahola ukuthola indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla eyihle.
examples.note: Isubjective esibili (if + past, would/could) siyithathwa ukuze kutholake izinto ezinye.

examples.original: How about reducing the quantity instead of the price?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ðə ˈkwɒntəti ɪnˈsted əv ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Yini na ukuba sikhethe ukuthola indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla esikhashana esikhashana?
examples.note: 'How about + -ing' iyisikhashana esikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa.

examples.original: Think of it this way: a lower upfront cost saves you money in the long run.
examples.phonetic: /θɪŋk əv ɪt ðɪs weɪ ə loʊər ʌpˈfrʌnt kɒst seɪvz ju ˈmʌni ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/
examples.translation: Cela ukukhumbula: ukuthola indawo yokusetshenziswa kwempahla eyiphansi kuyakusiza ngokukhulu ngosuku lwalokhu.
examples.note: Isikhashana 'Think of it this way' siyisikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa.

examples.original: Would you be open to a trial period for three months?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju bi ˈoʊpən tʊ ə ˈtraɪəl ˈpɪəriəd fɔː θriː mʌnθs/
examples.translation: Ingabe ningavuma ukuthola isikhathi esikhashana sokudlula?
examples.note: 'Open to' iyisikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa engathathwanga ngokwenze ngesiSpani; siyisikhashana esikhuluma ngokukhombisa.

examples.original: If we meet your deadline, will you extend the payment terms?
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi miːt jɔːr dedlaɪn wɪl ju ɪkˈstend ðə ˈpeɪmənt tɜːmz/
examples.translation: Uma sifinyelela esikhathini sakho, ingabe niyokukhulisa izinto ezinye?
examples.note: Isubjective esikhashana (if + present, will) siyithathwa ukuze kutholake izinto ezinye.

examples.original: I'm confident we can find a solution that works for both sides.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈkɒnfɪdənt wi kæn faɪnd ə səˈluːʃən ðæt wɜːks fɔːr boʊθ saɪdz/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholwa ukuthi singahlela ukuthola isikhwele esisebenzayo kubo bobabili.
examples.note: Ukusetshenziswa 'I'm confident' esikhundleni 'I think' kuyakukhombisa nokukhuluma ngokukhombisa.

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / Ukunika nokubeka izibonelo kakhulu
bridge: Ngesi, kunzima ukusebenzisa 'ngiyakholelwa ukuthi' noma 'ngiyabona ukuthi' nokubeka izibonelo nge-'ngoba'. NgesiNgelezi, ukubeka izibonelo kakhulu kudinga ukusebenzisa amazwi anjeng-‘the reason being’, ‘due to’, ‘given that’, neziqembu zokudla amaninga njengokuthi ‘if... then...’. Qhaqha ukuhumusha ngokwenhloso ‘ngokwemivelo yami’ (okuthi ‘according to my opinion’ - okungaphansi, kushiwo ‘in my opinion’). Ngokungalinzanga isiNgisi, amazwi okudla (would, could) avumelekile ukuze ahlasele izibonelo nokubonisa izinhloso.
rule: Ukunika izibonelo kakhulu ngesiNgelezi, sebenzisa: 1) Izibonelo zokubeka izibonelo: ‘In my view’, ‘From my perspective’, ‘I would argue that’, ‘It seems to me that’. 2) Ukubeka izibonelo: ‘The reason for this is’, ‘This is due to’, ‘Given that’, ‘Considering that’. 3) Ukuphikisana: ‘However’, ‘On the other hand’, ‘While it is true that...’, ‘Nevertheless’. 4) Izimo zokucabanga: ‘If... then’, ‘Unless...’, ‘Provided that...’. 5) Izinhlelo zokudlala: ‘This leads to’, ‘As a result’, ‘Consequently’. Inhloso ye-B2: Kulekelelwa ukuthi izinhloso eziphansi nezilimi ezinhloso zisebenzise ngokwenhloso. Lula ngokubeka amazwi okuhleka nokukhetha isikhathi esihle (present perfect vs. past simple) ukubeka izibonelo.

concept_examples.text: In my view, remote work has increased productivity, the reason being that employees avoid long commutes.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokwemivelo yami, umsebenzi owalayayo wazuzelela ukusebenza, ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi bahlutha izikhathi ezide zokuhamba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, rɪˈmoʊt wɜːrk hæz ˈɪnkriːst ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti, ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˌemploʊˈiːz əˈvɔɪd lɔːŋ kəˈmjuːts/

concept_examples.text: I would argue that investing in education yields long-term benefits, given that it improves social mobility.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ukusebenza kwesikolezi kuhlinzeka izenzo ezingaphambili, ngenxa yokuthi kuhlinzeka ukukhula kwebandla.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrgjuː ðæt ɪnˈvestɪŋ ɪn ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn jiːldz lɔːŋ tɜːrm ˈbenɪfɪts, ˈɡɪvn ðæt ɪt ɪmˈpruːvz ˈsoʊʃl moʊˈbɪləti/

concept_examples.text: From my perspective, the new policy is flawed, due to the fact that it ignores regional differences.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokwemivelo yami, umthetho omusha unembala, ngenxa yokuthi uyadeka izinhloso ezisodwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspektɪv, ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz flɔːd, djuː tuː ðə fækt ðæt ɪt ɪɡˈnɔːrz ˈriːdʒənl ˈdɪfrənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: It seems to me that we should prioritize renewable energy, otherwise we will face severe climate consequences.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyabona ukuthi siyadinga ukukhothamela amandla asezulwini, ngenxa yokuthi siyohlangabeza izimpawu ezimbi zokwesabeka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz tuː miː ðæt wiː ʃʊd praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈenərdʒi, ˈʌðəwaɪz wiː wɪl feɪs sɪˈvɪər ˈklaɪmət ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

common_error.wrong: According to my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct: In my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct_alt: From my point of view, the government should do more for education.
common_error.explanation: IsiNgisi sithi ‘ngokwemivelo yami’ (ngokwenhloso ‘according to my opinion’), kodwa ngesiNgelezi leli zibonelo alikho; ‘according to’ lisetshenziselwa nezenzo eziphambili (according to the report). Indlela efanele ngiyeyokuthi ‘in my opinion’ noma ‘from my point of view’. Leli camagu livamile kakhulu phakathi kwabashiNgisi ngenxa yokuthi isibonelo sasiNgisi ‘ngokwemivelo yami’ sanhliswa njengokuthi ‘according to’.

examples.original: In my view, the film was overrated.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, ðə fɪlm wɒz ˌoʊvərˈreɪtɪd/
examples.note: Sebenzisa ‘in my view’ ukubeka izibonelo okomthetho. Nalo ‘to my mind’ (ngokwemivelo yami) kodwa liyabasha kabanzi.

examples.original: I strongly believe that recycling should be mandatory.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔːŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətɔːri/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa kakhulu ukuthi ukusebenza kwesikolezi kuyadingeka.
examples.note: ‘Strongly believe’ kuhlinzeka ukudla; ngesiNgisi sisebenzisa ‘ngiyakholelwa kakhulu’.

examples.original: As far as I'm concerned, the project is on track.
examples.phonetic: /æz fɑːr æz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ɪz ɒn træk/
examples.note: Leli zibonelo livamile ukubeka ukuthi uyabeka izibonelo zakho.

examples.original: The reason being that prices have risen significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈrɪzən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.note: Lisetshenziselwa emva kokoma ukuze kubekwe izibonelo koko okudlulileyo.

examples.original: Due to the lack of funding, the program was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /djuː tuː ðə læk ɒv ˈfʌndɪŋ, ðə ˈproʊɡræm wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.note: ‘Due to’ liyabasha kabanzi kunokuthi ‘because of’. Lula ngokubeka ‘to’ futhi ungakhathazi ‘because’.

examples.original: Given that the economy is unstable, we should be cautious.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn ðæt ði ɪˈkɒnəmi ɪz ʌnˈsteɪbl, wiː ʃʊd biː ˈkɔːʃəs/
examples.translation: Ngenxa yokuthi ikhanda liyashintsha, siyadinga ukuba nokubona.
examples.note: ‘Given that’ livamile ukubeka umqondo noma isibonelo esaziwe.

examples.original: While it is true that technology has drawbacks, it also opens up new possibilities.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ɪt ɪz truː ðæt tekˈnɒlədʒi hæz ˈdrɔːbæks, ɪt ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈoʊpənz ʌp nuː ˌpɒsəˈbɪlətiz/
examples.translation: Nangona kunjalo ukuthi inkqubo iyatholakala, nayo ihlisa izimo ezisha.
examples.note: Leli qembu livamile ukubonisa ukuphika phakathi kwezibonelo ezimbili.

examples.original: Unless we address climate change now, future generations will suffer.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles wiː əˈdres ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃnz wɪl ˈsʌfər/
examples.translation: Ngaphandle kokuthi siyohlangabeza ukukhitha kwesabeka manje, izizukulwaneko ziyohlupheka.
examples.note: Sebenzisa ‘unless’ njengokuthi ‘ngaphandle kokuthi’ (ukudla okungaphansi).

examples.original: If the government invested more in healthcare, the overall well-being would improve.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt ɪnˈvestɪd mɔːr ɪn ˈhelθkeər, ði ˌoʊvərˈɔːl ˌwelˈbiːɪŋ wʊd ɪmˈpruːv/
examples.translation: Uma umphakathi wabeka imali eminingo, ukuhlula okukhulu kuyohlinzeka.
examples.note: Isikhathi esihlanu sokucabanga ngokungaphansi. NgisiNgelezi, sisebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo eziqembweni ‘if’.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Ukucabanga ngokubona ngokweshona
bridge: NgesiSpani, ukucabanga ngokubona ngokweshona kusetshenzwa ngokushwa 'habría + participio' okanye 'hubiera + participio', kodwa ngesiNgesi indlela iyahlukile: kusetshenzwa 'would have + past participle' ukuze kubonakale isiphetho nokushwa 'had + past participle' ukuze kubonakale umqondo (third conditional). Iphutha elichanekileyo yikushintsha ngokungaphezulu 'si habría' nge-'if would have', kodwa ngesiNgesi umqondo akaze athathe 'would'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgesi kukhona umsebenzi 'might have' nokushwa 'could have' ukuze kubonakale ukunakekela okanye ukwazi, okungashintshwa ngesiSpani nge-'podría haber' okanye 'quizás habría'.
rule: Ukuze ucabange ngokubona ngokweshona ngesiNgesi, kusetshenzwa 'third conditional' noma izinhlelo zokwazi eziphelele. Indlela ephakeme yikushwa: 'If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle'. Isibonelo: 'If I had studied, I would have passed'. Kusenjiwe noma izinhlelo: 'could have' (ukwazi okanye ukunakekela), 'might have' (ukunakekela), 'should have' (ukusitshela okanye ukukhazimula). Ekhulumeni elingasekela okanye ezimisweni zokudla, kusetshenzwa 'wish + past perfect' (ngiyakuthanda ukuba bekungaba). Akusetshenzwa 'would have' esihlahleni 'if'. Emibuzweni, isibonakaliso sikahlulwa: 'Would you have...?'

concept_examples.text: If I had known, I would have told you.
concept_examples.translation: Uma bekungibona, bekungikushayo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn, aɪ wʊd hæv toʊld juː/

concept_examples.text: She might have missed the train.
concept_examples.translation: Yena bekungahleka itreni.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn/

concept_examples.text: We could have won the match.
concept_examples.translation: Thina bekungasinda umdlalo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd hæv wʌn ðə mætʃ/

concept_examples.text: I wish I had studied more.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukuba bekungifunda ngokuningi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdɪd mɔːr/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Iphutha leliyoba yoba ngoba ngesiSpani kusho 'Si hubiera sabido' abafundi abanye bashintsha 'hubiera' nge-'would have', kodwa ngesiNgesi umqondo 'if' akathathi 'would'. Kufanele kusetshenzwe 'had + participio' esihlahleni esikhethayo. Ukuze uqhubeke, khumbula ukuthi 'would' kuphatha kuphela esihlahleni esiphethayo. Inye indlela efanelekileyo yikushintsha isibonakaliso nokushwa 'had': 'Had I known...'.

examples.original: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the flight.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd lɛft ˈɜːrliər, ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə flaɪt/
examples.translation: Uma yena bekusukela ngaphambi, bekungahleki iflight.
examples.note: Indlela ephakeme: 'If + past perfect, would not have + participio'.

examples.original: They would have arrived on time if the traffic hadn't been so bad.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wʊd hæv əˈraɪvd ɒn taɪm ɪf ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈhædnt biːn soʊ bæd/
examples.translation: Babezafika ngesikhathi uma isikhwele asikwazi ukuba ngakhona.
examples.note: Isihlahla 'if' singahamba ngemva ngaphandle koma.

examples.original: You should have called me.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv kɔːld miː/
examples.note: Ukuzetsha 'should have' ukuze kubonakale ukukhazimula okanye ukuxhumana.

examples.original: He could have been a doctor.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv biːn ə ˈdɒktər/
examples.note: Kuboniswa ukwazi okanye ukunakekela okungenzekanga.

examples.original: They might have forgotten the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.note: Kuboniswa ukunakekela okungavumelekanga ngeshona.

examples.original: I wish I had accepted the job offer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd əkˈsɛptɪd ðə dʒɒb ˈɒfər/
examples.note: Kusetshenzwa 'wish + past perfect' ukuze kubonakale ukuxhumana.

examples.original: If only we had listened to the weather forecast.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈoʊnli wiː hæd ˈlɪsənd tuː ðə ˈwɛðər ˈfɔːrkæst/
examples.note: 'If only' yindlela efanelekileyo yokudla okungenzekanga.

title: Discussing abstract concepts / Ukuthetha ngamacacile amaningi
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze sicazise izimvo zamacacile, siyaxhamla ukusebenzisa isubjunctive ('is important that...', 'I believe it to be...') kanye nezimisomo eziningi. NgesiNgisi, ukusebenza kwe-subjunctive kudingeka kakhulu: kuhlanganisa izincazelo njengokuthi 'suggest', 'recommend', 'demand', kanye nezacacile ezinomthelela 'it is essential that...'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi, amazwana amaningi njengokuthi 'freedom' noma 'justice' axhaswa ngokuvamile ngaphandle kwesiga esiqinisekisi xa kukhulunywa ngazo ngokubanzi, ngakube ngeSpanish ngokuvamile kune 'la' ('la libertad'). Khumbula futhi ukuthi ngesiNgisi kusetshenziswa isikhathi esisodwa 'do' ukubuza futhi ukuba ungavumi, futhi amazwana angeke avume nomphathi.
rule: Ukuze ubekeze izimvo zamacacile ngesiNgisi kwesikhala saseB2, ufanele ubone: 1. Amazwana amaningi ezingelisi/plural enokuba nge 'zero article' ukuthetha ngokubanzi ('Freedom is important' vs 'La libertad es importante'). 2. Izincazelo ezihlobene ne 'that' + isikhathi esisodwa (subjunctive) emva kwemezwi ukukhokha noma ukukhokha ('I suggest that she be...') kanye namazwana amaningi ('It is crucial that he attend'). 3. Izimisomo zokucacisa izimvo: 'In my opinion', 'I believe that', 'It seems to me that', esebenzisa ukuxhumana (kungekudla kwesiSpanish esikhathini eside). 4. Ukusebenza kwemezwi ezinomthelela 'which' kanye ne 'that' ukuze kubekeze kanye nokungabeki. 5. Izincazelo zokukhokha ukuze kukhokwe: 'might', 'could', 'would', 'should' ukuze kubekeze ukukhetha, ukubeka noma ukukhokha. 6. Izacacile ezingelisi enomthelela 'it' ('It is obvious that', 'It is worth considering'). Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi akukho ukungavuma okwesibini, futhi isimo somsebenzi ngumsebenzi + Isikhathi + Into.

concept_examples.text: Freedom is not just a political idea, but a personal value.

concept_examples.text: I believe that happiness depends more on our attitude than on our circumstances.

common_error.wrong: It is important that we will respect the environment.
common_error.correct: It is important that we respect the environment.
common_error.correct_alt: It is important that we should respect the environment.
common_error.explanation: Impazamo eyayiziqondile: ukusebenza 'will' emva kwezacacile njengokuthi 'it is important that' ngenxa yokuthi isiSpanish isebenzisa isubjunctiwe esizayo ('será importante que respetemos'). NgesiNgisi, emva kwezindaba nezincazelo, kusetshenziswa isubjunctiwe esikhathini esisodwa (isimo sesikhathi esisodwa somsebenzi) noma, okuningi, 'should' + ukukhokha. Ungasetshenzisi 'will' kulesi siga esihlobene.

title: Expressing complex emotions / Ukubeka izimiso eziqondile ezokwemvelo
bridge: Ngesi, siyathusa ukusebenzisa amazwi okuthanda 'to be' + isifundo esithi 'to feel' ukubeka izimiso, kodwa ngesi kuthunyelwe izinhlelo ezahlukahlukene, njengamathululu okuthanda, izinkulumo ezinesikhombisa, nokulandelana kwesiluleko. Isiphambano esikhuluma ngaso kakhulu yikuthi ukuhumusha ngokomfanekiso 'nginekhuba lakho' njengokuthi 'I have fear of' esikhundleni sokuthi 'I'm afraid of'. Ngaphambi kwalokho, ngesi kuhlukanisa izimiso ezingenakulinganiswa ngesi ngokuphelele, njengokuthi 'frustrated' (frustrated) vs. 'annoyed' (molesto), okanye 'overwhelmed' (abrumado) enginakho isilinganiso esihle. Khomba ukubeka izimiso nezifundo eziyeyiswayo ngokuhumusha.
rule: Ukubeka izimiso eziqondile ngesi, kuthunyelwe izinhlelo eziyeyiswayo: 1) Izifundo ezinesikhombisa: 'angry about/at', 'frustrated with', 'disappointed in/with', 'excited about', 'worried about', 'ashamed of', 'proud of'. 2) Izinhlelo ezinesikhombisa 'feel' + isifundo okanye 'feel like' + ukusebenza ukubeka izimiso eziphakemeyo. 3) Izinhlelo ezinesikhombisa 'get' + isifundo ukubeka ukuguqula kwesimo somvelo (get frustrated, get overwhelmed). 4) Izifundo eziqondile ezinesikhombisa ukubeka izimiso eziqondile: 'homesick', 'heartbroken', 'overwhelmed'. 5) Izinhlelo ezinesikhombisa ukubeka izimiso eziqondile: 'on cloud nine' (kumnandi kakhulu), 'down in the dumps' (deprimido). Khumbula ukuthi 'nervous' kuthunyelwa ukubeka ukwesaba, 'anxious' kungaba yikubeka ukwesaba okukhulu; 'upset' kukhulu kunokuthi 'sad'. Ungathusi 'I have' nezimiso ngesi, ngaphandle kwesikhathi esithi 'I have a feeling'.

title: Formal Writing: Reports and Emails / Isandla esihle sokuqala nokuphepha: Izibalo nezimelo
bridge: Ngesibhashi, isandla esihle sokuqala nokuphepha sizama ukuba sibe yimbi kwaye sizame ukusebenzisa izinqubo eziphindekile nezincazelo eziphambili. NgesiNgisi, ukuhleka kuholwa ngokucacile nokuncane. Isiphambano esiqhelekileyo yikuhumusha ngokudodana 'Le adjunto' njengokuthi 'I attach' (okungavumelekile) esikhundleni se- 'Please find attached' okanye 'I have attached'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha, amazwi athintha ukubeka njengokuthi 'would' futhi 'could' ayabalulekile ukuze kuholwe ngokuhle, ngakho-ke ngesibhashi sizama ukusebenzisa ukubeka okwethu okusengati ('Podría'). Inye indaba ebalulekile: ngesiNgisi awusebenzisi 'usted' okanye ukubeka okwethu okwengeziwe ukuze kuholwe ngokuhle, kodwa usebenzisa ulwazi oluthembekile kwaye amazwi athandekile.
rule: Ukuqala nokuphepha izibalo nezimelo ezihle ngesiNgisi ekwiphezulu laseB2, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa indlela efanelekile yokukhuluma ngokuthi: 1) Izinqubo zokubonga nokuphepha: 'Dear Mr. Smith', 'Dear Madam', 'Yours sincerely', 'Yours faithfully'. 2) Amazwi nokubeka okwethu okwengeziwe: 'state' (esikhundleni se- 'say'), 'require' (esikhundleni se- 'need'), 'I would like to' (esikhundleni se- 'I want'), 'I am writing to inform you'. 3) Isimo sezincazelo: isincazelo esiqalayo, umzimba nezincazelo eziqondile, nokuphepha nezincazelo eziqondile okanye isibalo. 4) Ukunciphisa ukubeka okwethu: bhala 'do not' esikhundleni se- 'don't', 'I would' esikhundleni se- 'I'd'. 5) Kuzibalo: sebenzisa izinhloko eziqondile njengokuthi 'Introduction', 'Findings', 'Recommendations', neluleko olungaphansi komuntu njengokuthi 'It was found that...' (Kutholake kwathi...). 6) Amazwi athintha ukubeka ukuze kuholwe ngokuhle: 'Could you please...', 'I would appreciate...', 'Would it be possible to...?'. Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha awusebenzisi 'please' ekupheleni kwesenzo (lokho kuhleka kakhulu), kodwa usebenzisa ngokuqala okanye ngaphambi komuzi.

concept_examples.text: Please find attached the requested documents for your review.

concept_examples.phonetic: pliːz faɪnd əˈtætʃt ðə rɪˈkwestɪd ˈdɒkjʊmənts fɔː jɔː rɪˈvjuː.

concept_examples.text: I would be grateful if you could provide us with further details.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakuthanda ukuba ungakunika izincazelo ezingakusiza.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfʊl ɪf juː kʊd prəˈvaɪd ʌs wɪð ˈfɜːðə ˈdiːteɪlz.

concept_examples.phonetic: jɔːz sɪnˈsɪəli, dʒɒn smɪθ.

common_error.wrong: I am writing to complaint about the service.
common_error.correct: I am writing to complain about the service.
common_error.correct_alt: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano yikusebenzisa 'complaint' (igama) esikhundleni se- 'complain' (umuzi) emva kwesona 'to'. NgesiBhashi, 'queja' lingasebenzisa njengogama, kodwa ngesiNgisi kudingeka umuzi 'complain'. Inye isiphambano esiqhelekileyo yikuhumusha ngokudodana 'me quejo de' njengokuthi 'I complain of' lapho eqiniso kukhona 'I complain about'. Ukuze ukhumbuze, khumbula ukuthi emva kwesona 'to' kudingeka umuzi oqalayo: 'to complain'.

examples.original: Dear Sir or Madam,
examples.phonetic: dɪə sɜːr ɔːr ˈmædəm,
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa lapho akwazi igama lomthwebi. NgesiBhashi kusetshenziswa 'Estimado/a señor/a', kodwa ngesiNgisi kuhle kakhulu ukusetshenzisa 'Dear Sir or Madam'.

examples.original: Dear Ms. García,
examples.phonetic: dɪə mɪz ɡɑːrˈsiːə,
examples.note: NgesiNgisi, 'Ms.' ayibonisi umphumela, ngenhlikaniso 'Señora' engase benzise. Cipha 'Mrs.' ngaphandle ukuba uyakwazi ukuthi uyezekile.

examples.original: Yours faithfully,
examples.phonetic: jɔːz ˈfeɪθfʊli,
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa lapho ukubonga kwakho kwakungokuthi 'Dear Sir or Madam'. NgesiBhashi kusetshenziswa 'Atentamente' emibilini, kodwa ngesiNgisi kukhona ukubaluleka: 'Yours faithfully' ukubonga okungaphansi komuntu nokubonga okwaziwe.

examples.original: Yours sincerely,
examples.phonetic: jɔːz sɪnˈsɪəli,
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa lapho ubhale 'Dear Mr. Smith'. Beka ukuthi 'sincerely' kubhalwa 'c', hhayi 'z' njengokuthi 'sinceramente' ngesiBhashi.

examples.original: Could you please send me the updated schedule?
examples.phonetic: kʊd juː pliːz send miː ðiː ʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈʃedjuːl?
examples.note: NgesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha, 'Could you please' kuhle kakhulu kunokuthi 'Can you'. NgesiBhashi kusetshenziswa 'Podría' okungafana.

examples.original: I would appreciate your response at your earliest convenience.
examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd əˈpriːʃieɪt jɔː rɪˈspɒns æt jɔː ˈɜːlɪəst kənˈviːniəns.
examples.note: Lolu khozo luhle kakhulu futhi lusetshenziswa ngesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha. NgesiBhashi kufanane: 'agradecería su respuesta tan pronto como sea posible'.

examples.original: Would it be possible to schedule a meeting next week?
examples.phonetic: wʊd ɪt biː ˈpɒsəbəl tə ˈʃedjuːl ə ˈmiːtɪŋ nekst wiːk?
examples.translation: Ingabe kunzima ukubeka isikhathi esisha iviki elizayo?
examples.note: Lolu khozo olusebenzisa 'would' luhle kakhulu. NgesiBhashi, 'sería posible' kufanane, kodwa ngesiNgisi kuhle kakhulu kunokuthi 'es posible'.

examples.original: The purpose of this report is to analyze the sales data for the third quarter.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈpɜːpəs əv ðɪs rɪˈpɔːt ɪz tə ˈænəlaɪz ðə seɪlz ˈdeɪtə fɔː ðə θɜːd ˈkwɔːtə.
examples.translation: Isibalo sasezibalo kulesibalo ukubeka izibalo zezibalo kwendawo yesikhashana sesithathu.
examples.note: NgesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha kusetshenziswa 'the purpose of this report is to...' ukuze kufakwe izibuyezo. NgesiBhashi kusetshenziswa 'El propósito de este informe es...' kodwa kuhle kakhulu ukusetshenzisa 'El objetivo de este informe...'.

examples.original: It was found that customer satisfaction has increased by 15%.
examples.phonetic: ɪt wɒz faʊnd ðæt ˈkʌstəmər ˌsætɪsˈfækʃən hæz ɪnˈkriːst baɪ fɪfˈtiːn pəˈsent.
examples.translation: Kutholake kwathi ukuthokozeka kwabathengi kwehlela ngamashumi amane okungamashumi amabili.
examples.note: NgesiNgisi esihle sokuqala nokuphepha kusetshenziswa umuzi oyingaphansi komuntu 'it was found that...' ukuze kuncishwe ukuthi ubani owafumana. NgesiBhashi, kusetshenziswa 'se encontró que' okungafana.

examples.original: Based on the findings, we recommend implementing a new training program.

examples.translation: Ngesibonelo sezibalo, siyakukhothalisa ukubeka imali entengo entsha.

title: Dealing with Conflict / Ukudiliza amathuba nokungavumelani
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, siyathanda ukusebenzisa umthelela oqondile ('Ngitshela ukuthi kwenzeka njani') noma izakhamuzi ezinye zokuthi 'kufanele' ukudiliza amathuba. Ngesilinganiso, ukuba nobuntu nokucisha kuhlula kudingeka: kushiywa amagama okusebenza njengokuthi 'could' futhi 'might', futhi amazwi njengoka-'I feel...' esikhundleni sokubekezela okwaziwa. Igazi elikhula kakhulu ukubhala ngokwaziwa 'you must' njengokuthi 'you must', lokhu kuvele kukhulu; esikhundleni, kushiywa 'you might want to' noma 'maybe you could'.
rule: Ukudiliza amathuba ngesilinganiso ehlela B2, kushiywa izinhlelo zokuba nobuntu futhi ulimi olungavumelani. Izinhlelo eziqondile ziyini: 1) Amagama okusebenza ukusuka ezisukweni ezincane: 'could', 'might', 'would' (okuj. 'We could try...'). 2) Izinkulumo zokubeka izinqumo zakho nge-'I feel', 'I think', 'I believe' ukuze kuncishwe ukubekezela. 3) Izinhlelo zokubeka izinqumo: 'If you..., we could...'. 4) Izinkulumo zokubonisa ukubeka izinqumo: 'I understand', 'I see your point'. 5) Imibuzo engavumelani: 'I wonder if you could...'. 6) Ukusebenzisa 'sorry' ukudiliza ngaphandle kokubeka izinqumo okugcwele: 'I'm sorry if that came across the wrong way'. Hleka ukusebenzisa umthelela oqondile futhi ukubekezela nge-'you' (okuj. 'You are wrong') kuba kuvele kukhulu. Esikhundleni, shiya 'I'm not sure that's accurate' noma 'I see it differently'.

title: Summarising and Paraphrasing / Ukucondza nokuhlaziyeka
bridge: NgesiSpani, siyahlaziyeka ngokusebenzisa 'o sea', 'es decir' ne-'en resumen', kodwa ngesiNgesi, ama-discourse markers amaningi kabanzi futhi ahleli ekuqaleni lohlelo noma phakathi kwayo nekhomuhla. Qaphela: ngesiNgesi awusekiwa 'in summary' njengokuthi 'in short' noma 'to sum up', futhi isihloko 'summarize' sithetha ngesithathuxiation esokuqaleni. Inye indaba engikhundayo yikuthi ngesiSpani siyabeka isihloko ngokubanjalo, kodwa ngesiNgesi ukusebenzisa amagama abonisa ubudlelane nokuhlaziyeka kukhulunywa kakhulu, kodwa akuseke ukususa isihloko ezihlathululweni ezikhethekile.
rule: Ukucondza nokuhlaziyeka ngesiNgesi ehlela B2, kusetshenziswa amagama njengokuthi 'summarize', 'paraphrase', 'outline', 'restate', nezihloko ezisebenzisana njengokuthi 'in other words', 'that is', 'to put it briefly', 'in a nutshell', 'to sum up', 'in short', 'all in all' ne-'to recap'. Isimo esijwayelekile nguku: [Isihloko esisebenzisana] + [isihloko esinekhono lokucondza]. Xa uhlaziyeka, ushintsha isimo somthetho (ngokwesibonelo, ukusuka kwesandi esisebenzayo kwesandi esingasebenzi, noma ukusuka kwesihloko esingcono kwesihloko esingamaqondana) kodwa usagcina umthetho. Amaqondana: 'The study reveals a significant increase...' → 'In other words, the numbers went up a lot.' Ukucondza umbhalo, ungase usaqala ngokuthi 'The text is about...' noma 'The author argues that...'. Kufuneka uhlangane nokuhumusha ngokokwenziwayo 'en resumen' njengokuthi 'in summary' ezimpendulweni ezingasemi; ukhethe 'in short' noma 'to sum up'. Nakhu qaphela ukusebenzisa 'actually' (okuthetha 'ngempela', hhayi 'manje'), kodwa ukucondza kusetshenziswa 'in fact' noma 'actually' ngokwanele.

title: Using Idioms Naturally / Isebenzisa izibonelo ngokomhlayo
bridge: Ngesi, izibonelo ziyavela ezihlathululweni kakhulu futhi ngokuvamile zisetshenziselwa nezenzo njengokuthi 'tener' okanye 'estar' (ngokwesibonelo, 'estar como una cabra'). NgesiNgisi, izibonelo eziningi ziyakhiwa kwezenzo zokudlala futhi amazwi oqondile, futhi ngokuvamile ziyacosha futhi ziyakhuluma ngokukhululekile. Isixandu esikhazimulayo yikuthi ubhalela ngokukhululekile izibonelo zesiNgisi kusiNgisi (ngokwesibonelo, 'to have a good face' esikhundleni se- 'to be in a good mood'). Ngaphandle kwalokho, isiNgisi isetshenzisa isenzo 'to be' ngokuvamile ekujuleni njengokuthi 'be over the moon', ngesikhathi isiNgisi isetshenzisa 'estar' okanye 'tener'. Khomba ukubeka: ezinye izibonelo ziyavela ekuxhumaneni ('kick the bucket') futhi ezinye ziyavela ekuxhumaneni okuningi ('pass away').
rule:
Ukuzetsha izibonelo ngesiNgisi ngokomhlayo, landela lawa migaqulo:
1. Funda izibonelo njengamagangatho acacile, hhayi ilizwi ngelizwi.
2. Ziba ukubeka: okukhululekile, okungekho, okusebenzayo okanye okubi. Ngokwesibonelo, 'to be over the moon' yikho kakhulu, kodwa 'to be delighted' iyavela ekuxhumaneni okuningi.
3. Izibonelo eziningi zinehloso elihambisana okungaveliwe yilizwi. Ngokwesibonelo, 'break the ice' ayikho isisho elisho ngokukhululekile ukuphuca umoya, kodwa ukuqala ukuxoxa emoyeni oyingozi.
4. Ziyavela ekuxoxeni kwezinsuku zonke, kodwa ekubhalweni okwesikole okanye okusebenzi zisetshenziswa ngokuncane.
5. Ezinye izibonelo zinezigqebho eziyingwini (ngokwesibonelo, 'to be in hot water' kusiNgisi saseMelika vs. 'to be in a pickle' kusiNgisi saseMelika futhi saseNgisi saseNgisi).
6. Ukukhuluma futhi ukubhala kuhluza: izibonelo ngokuvamile zikhulunywa ngomthelela wokukhuluma oqondile, futhi ukuqhekeza kuhambisana ekuxhumaneni okungekho (ngokwesibonelo, 'it's raining cats and dogs').
7. Akasozonke izibonelo ziyazenzo; ezinye ziyizincazelo okanye amazwi oqondile (ngokwesibonelo, 'a piece of cake' = into eyecinezelayo).
8. Qalisa izikhathi zokukhuluma: izibonelo eziningi zikhishwa ngesikhathi esidlulile (ngokwesibonelo, 'he bit the bullet'), ngakho-ke qala ukusetshenzisa izikhathi eziyingozi.

title: Academic and Professional Register / Irejista yokufunda neyasebenza
bridge: Kulingesi yokufunda neyasebenza, ukude nokwenzelela kuthiwe ngokuvamile ngemisindo yezimpawu, amamodali okunokwenzeka nokunomiza izinhlobo, ngakho-ke kisiZulu sizama ukusebenzisa isikhathi esisebenza kabanzi nezakhiwo ezingumuntu njengokuthi ‘si’ okanye ‘omunye’. Iphutha elibikiswa ngumuntu othetha isiZulu ukubhala ngokungaphezulu ‘Kuthiwe ukuthi...’ ngokungaphandle kokubona ukuthi ingesi idinga umuntu oqondile okanye impawu enkulu. Nokho, kudingeka ukusebenzisa ‘would’, ‘could’ ne-‘might’ ukuze kuncishiswe izinto, okungokuthi kisiZulu kuthiwe ngokuthi ‘kungenzeka’ kodwa kudingeka umodali oqondile kabanzi ne-base verb ngaphandle kokuthi ‘to’. Hamba ngaphandle kokungabikwa: ‘can’ ne-‘will’ zikuvamile, kodwa kwezifundo kudingeka ‘may’ ne-‘would’.
rule: Kulingesi yokufunda neyasebenza, kudingeka ukusebenzisa impawu eyizibopho ( ‘It was decided...’) esikhundleni somuntu ( ‘We decided...’) ukuze kuhambe ngaphandle kokubaluleka komuntu. Amamodali okunokwenzeka ( ‘may’, ‘might’, ‘could’) athiwe ukuze kuxhumene ngaphandle kokubeka intando, ne-‘would’ ukuze kuthiwe ngokwenelela. Ukunomiza izinhlobo (ukuhlinzeka izinhlobo, ngokomzekelo, ‘to decide’ → ‘decision’) kunjalo kwezifundo. Ngezakhiwo esijweni, kuhambisana nokuncishiswa (don't → do not), futhi kudingeka ukusebenzisa izinhlaka ezifundekayo njengokuthi ‘however’, ‘furthermore’, ‘nevertheless’. Ngokungalindidingi, isiZulu esifundekayo isebenzisa kabanzi umuntu othetha kabanzi nezakhiwo ezingumuntu njengokuthi ‘si’, kanye ne-conditional simple ( ‘sería’, ‘podría’) ukuze kuthiwe ngokwenelela. Khumbula ukuthi ingesi ayinayo ukuhlangana kwesilo/isihloko, kodwa idinga umuntu oqondile (ngaphandle kwesilathiso) nokuthoma kwesikhathi ngokuvamile. KU-B2, kudingeka ukubaluleka impawu ngekhathi elula, amamodali okunokwenzeka ngekhathi elula nelapho ( ‘could have done’), nokusebenzisa ‘would’ nge-conditional ukuze kuthiwe ngokwenelela.

common_error.explanation: Iphutha elibikiswa ngumuntu othetha isiZulu ukubhala ngokungaphezulu ‘Kuthiwe ukuthi...’ njengokuthi ‘It says that...’ okanye ‘Se says that...’ esikhundleni sokusebenzisa impawu eyizibopho ‘It is said that...’. KisiZulu, impawu eyizibopho ne-‘se’ iyamemeza ukuba ingane, kodwa kulingesi akukho okuqukethwe; kuthiwe ‘It + impawu’ okanye ‘Abantu/They’ njengomuntu. Hamba ngaphandle kokuthi ‘Se says’ (ukuhlanganyela kwebhala) khumbula ukuthi impawu eyizibopho idinga isihloko ‘to be’ + okusetshenziswe, ne-pronoun ‘It’ njengomuntu oqondile.
